response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong technical fundamentals with 20+ years of production-scale software engineering across required languages and proven IC leadership, the resume critically lacks domain expertise in experimentation platforms, A/B testing frameworks, metrics infrastructure, and statistical analysis—core competencies essential for a Principal-level role focused on Growth/Experimentation Systems. This is not a ramp-up position, and the domain gap is too significant despite his strong general engineering capabilities.
strengths: 20+ years of production-scale software engineering with proficiency in all required languages (TypeScript, Java, C++, C, C#) and demonstrated expertise handling high-load systems (Dunnhumby: millions of requests/second with low-latency requirements)

Proven IC leadership through multiple Staff roles, open-source projects (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts, Trial), and structured mentorship activities (workshops, courses, Refactoring Dojos) showing ability to drive technical initiatives across teams

Deep hands-on engineering capability with full-stack expertise across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems, fulfilling Principal-level requirement to remain actively coding and conducting technical reviews
concerns: No demonstrated experience building experimentation platforms, A/B testing frameworks, feature-flagging systems, or rollout-risk management infrastructure—core to this role's focus on growth and experimentation systems

Lack of metrics infrastructure, telemetry, or statistical analysis background; no evidence of work on data-driven platforms or experimental design, which is critical for high data aptitude requirement

Resume shows broad technical versatility but lacks depth in specialized domain; no evidence of designing unified measurement systems or foundational platforms enabling multi-team experimentation workflows

key_factors.factor: Experimentation and metrics platform expertise gap
IC leadership and hands-on technical capability
